entries.name: Probabilistic Revshare Generator - Web Monetization
entries.description: Probabilistic revenue sharing (revshare) is one way to share a portion of a web monetized pages earnings between multiple payment pointers.Use this tool to define a list of payment pointers and their weights. Then, add the generated monetization link element to your site. The link will contain a unique URL hosted on https://webmonetization.org/api/revshare/pay/. If you'd prefer to not use a hosted URL, you can set up revshare by adding a script to your site.
